bull_case_summary: UnitedHealth has multi-period underwriting improvement and completed $4.813bn net repayments with debt falling to $73.328bn. Round two uses those realised outcomes to avoid assuming unrestricted insurer cash and defend recovery at 16.64x forecasts.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts substantive recovery beyond guidance and acknowledges repayments occurred under real constraints. Remaining debt, medical-cost recurrence and falling Optum Rx scripts can interrupt the path, while October 13 is an information event.
key_points_of_agreement: Underwriting and financial repair are observed across periods.
Completed repayments answer hypothetical cash-transfer assumptions.
Regulated cash is not consequently freely distributable.
key_points_of_disagreement: How far underwriting/debt progress compensates remaining leverage and medical/Optum sensitivity for aggressive purchase.
unresolved_uncertainties: Future claims-cost durability and Optum execution.
Actual October results and delivery of raised annual outlook.
